versions.content: If UdpNmNodeDetectionEnabled and UdpNmRepeatMsgIndEnabled are set to TRUE and Repeat Message Request bit is received, UdpNm module shall call the callback function Nm_RepeatMessageIndication.

{DRAFT} If UdpNmRepeatMsgIndEnabled is set to TRUE and the Repeat Message Request bit set to 1 is received UdpNm module shall call the callback function Nm_RepeatMessageIndication. In case the Partial Network Learning Bit is also received and UdpNmDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE the parameter pnLearningBitSet in this function call shall be set to TRUE, otherwise to FALSE.
